title.en: enchant christmas opens at nationals park.
title.de: enchant christmas öffnet im nationals park.

line.en: opening night of the run, with the new nutcracker light maze. open 16:30 to 22:30 daily until 27 december; come at 17:00, before the crowd.
line.de: eröffnungsabend der saison mit dem neuen nutcracker-lichterlabyrinth. täglich 16:30 bis 22:30 bis 27. dezember; um 17:00 kommen, vor dem andrang.
line.tr: sezonun açılış gecesi, yeni nutcracker ışık labirenti ile. her gün 16:30 ile 22:30 arası, 27 aralığa kadar; kalabalıktan önce 17:00'de gelin.

sparks.why: Enchant Christmas opens 20 nov at Nationals Park, daily 16:30-22:30 to 27 dec, with the new Night of the Nutcracker maze (washington.org event listing; Enchant opening-night announcement via the MLB listing).
